components.name: SliderField
components.description:
Figma Slider/Field (15662:108207): a number that is also a slider. The whole field is the track: the Fill shows the
value inside min–max, the label sits left and the number right. Drag anywhere to scrub (State=Dragging), click
without dragging to type an exact number (State=Typing, the fill hides; Enter or leaving applies, Escape drops it),
arrow keys step (Shift: ten steps, Home / End: the limits). Input tokens: Input/Size Medium 40 · Small 32,
Input/Spacing paddings and gap, Corner-Radius/Input, Input/Background and Input/Border per state, Effect/Input; the
fill is Background/Neutral/Subtle/Hover (Dragging: Pressed), Accent: Background/Accent/Subtle/Hover (Pressed); the
label Body/Base/Medium in Content/Neutral/Light, the number in Content/Neutral/Strongest. For a value tuned by feel
without a number use Slider; for an exact quantity with steppers, NumberField.

props.name: label
props.description: What the number is (Figma `Label`), inside the field on the left: "Offset X", "Duration".

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The first number when uncontrolled. Default: min.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the new number while scrubbing, on each arrow key and when a typed number is applied.

props.name: step
props.description: The step of arrows and scrubbing; typed numbers round to it too. Default 1.

props.name: formatValue
props.description: The text of the number (Figma `Value`), e.g. `(v) => \`${v} px\``. Default: the number with the step's decimals.

props.name: theme
props.description: The fill's colour: neutral (default) or accent.

props.name: size
props.description: Input sizes: md 40 (default), sm 32. Short or Figma spelling.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Name for assistive technology when `label` is not plain text.
